I added a 0.25s sleep after each request in `tests/test_payments.py`, so the test now makes at most 4 requests per second, under the sandbox's limit of 5. I haven't run the test, since it calls the live sandbox.

The interval is a named constant, `CALL_INTERVAL_S`, with a comment explaining the limit. The sleep adds about 1 second to the test.

I also saved the 5 requests per second limit to EngramDB as a hazard note, so future integration tests that loop over sandbox calls will see it.
